### One value per participant and ID

The ANOVA wants a single value per participant and per condition: we make the average.

```{r average}
data_anova <- df %>%
  group_by(GROUP, SUBJ, ID) %>%
  summarise(MT = mean(MT), .groups = "drop")
```

### ANOVA

```{r anova}
anova_res <- ezANOVA(data = data_anova,
                     dv = MT,
                     wid = SUBJ,
                     within = ID,
                     between = GROUP,
                     detailed = FALSE)
anova_res$ANOVA
```

Movement time increased with difficulty, F(1, 48) = 30.78, p < .001. This increase was different between the groups, F(2, 48) = 11.58, p < .001.
